definitions.explanation: A swollen part of the body, from injury, infection, an insect bite and so on; also the state of being swollen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{足首|あしくび}→足首：00918_ashikubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腫|は}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{引|ひ}かない→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: The swelling in my ankle just won't go down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刺|さ}された→刺す：02111_sasu⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腫|は}れ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{冷|ひ}やす→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{治|おさ}まる→治まる：27790_osamaru⟧。
examples.english: Swelling from an insect bite settles faster if you cool it.

notes:
The noun form of {腫|は}れる (to swell).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腫|は}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: the swelling goes down
- {腫|は}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧: the swelling is bad
- {腫|は}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to reduce swelling
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腫|は}れ: puffy eyes

WATCH OUT:
⟦{晴|は}れ→晴れ：02936_hare⟧ (clear weather) has the same reading.
